name: Developer Tool Caches
description: Package caches for npm, pip, Cargo and Gradle. Off by default: they are re-downloadable rather than lost, but clearing one turns your next build into a long one.

rules.reason: npm's package cache. Everything here can be downloaded again, but your next install will be slower and will need a network connection.
pip's wheel cache. Everything here can be downloaded again, but your next install will be slower and will need a network connection.
Cargo's downloaded crate archives. Cargo re-fetches them on the next build that needs them, so this costs build time rather than data.
Gradle's dependency and build cache. Gradle rebuilds it on the next build, which will take considerably longer than usual.
